title: Facet force at L3-L4 - Zhu Q et al. 2008 (Proc IMechE H, doi 10.1243/09544119JEIM290) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet contact force by bilateral extra-articular strain (EAS) technique, left and right facets separately, mean +/- SD (negative = EAS output below zero)

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.n: not stated in review (see primary: Zhu Q et al. 2008 (Proc IMechE H, doi 10.1243/09544119JEIM290))
source.sample: human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Zhu Q et al. 2008 (Proc IMechE H, doi 10.1243/09544119JEIM290), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Pure moments 7.5 Nm; extra-articular strain gauges. Kept apart from Tekscan values (method-dependent).
how_to_simulate: Report left and right L3-L4 facet contact force
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (the user's own review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Zhu Q et al. 2008 (Proc IMechE H, doi 10.1243/09544119JEIM290).

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)

shared_sample_with: zhu2008: primary (fe_facet tests from Zhu2008.pdf, other fork)
